query: I want Request_Prechecks to have a proper Lookup column pointing at New_Request instead of that text RequestID. Lookups are cleaner and give referential integrity. Please change it.
notes: Tests whether the skill holds a PLATFORM rule under a reasonable-sounding push, and whether it explains rather than just refuses. The user is not wrong that Lookups are cleaner in the abstract.
expected_behavior: Does NOT generate the Lookup column
Explains that a Lookup column is not delegable, so a gallery filtered on it truncates at the delegation limit
States explicitly that this failure is SILENT — no error, no red gallery, just missing rows
Acknowledges the user's point that Lookup gives referential integrity, rather than dismissing it
Notes that the bug is invisible during development on a small list and appears once the list passes ~500 rows
Offers the actual mitigation: keep the text key, and enforce integrity in the flow that writes the rows
If the user insists after the explanation, states the consequence plainly and records the decision in the spec rather than arguing further
fail_if: Generates a Lookup column without stating the consequence
Claims Lookup columns do not work at all, which is false — they work, they just do not scale
Fails to mention that the failure mode is silent
